# /reviewer:update

This legacy Claude Code command selects mode `update` from the
canonical [skills/agent-reviewer/SKILL.md](../skills/agent-reviewer/SKILL.md) workflow.

Pass `$ARGUMENTS` unchanged to that mode. The canonical skill owns validation,
defaults, resources, safety rules, stop conditions, and artifact paths.

Established usage:

```text
/reviewer:update <login>
/reviewer:update <login> --add-repo <repo>
/reviewer:update <login> --since <YYYY-MM-DD>
```
